title: Suspected China-Nexus Actor Exploits VMware vCenter Flaw, Deploys Babuk-Derived Ransomware
rss_summary:

The attacks involve the exploitation of CVE-2026-59310 (CVSS score: 9.8), a severe directory-traversal vulnerability in the VMware vCenter server that could be weaponized by a malicious actor to execute arbitrary code
ai_summary: A suspected China-nexus APT exploited CVE-2026-59310, a directory-traversal vulnerability in VMware vCenter, to deploy Babuk-derived ransomware.

title: Chaos ransomware's msaRAT: Living off the browser to build a covert C2 channel
rss_summary: The Chaos ransomware group uses new malware "msaRAT" that hijacks browsers. The malware doesn't communicate directly with C2 but connects through the browser. It enables arbitrary command execution while hiding the attacker's IP from victims via WebRTC over TURN.
ai_summary: The Chaos ransomware group employs msaRAT, a malware that hijacks browsers to establish covert C2 communication channels. The malware executes arbitrary commands while masking the attacker's IP address through WebRTC over TURN protocols, avoiding direct C2 communication.

title: Hackers Breach Polish Power Plant Controls via Private Cellular Network and Shut Turbine
rss_summary:
Attackers shut down a steam turbine and the process-water treatment system at a Polish combined heat and power plant by coming in over the private cellular network the local grid operator uses to reach remote equipment.

ai_summary: Attackers breached a Polish combined heat and power plant through a private cellular network used by the grid operator, shutting down a steam turbine and process-water treatment system. The plant supplies heat to approximately 50,000 residents. Recovery began while attackers remained active on the network, with no heat loss to customers.
